Usage:
  guardiana observe [--listen IP:PORT] [--upstream IP[:PORT]]... [--db PATH] [--canary] [--open] [--no-panel] [--panel-listen IP:PORT]
  guardiana ledger [--check | --wipe | --self | --last N] [--db PATH]
  guardiana export [--csv | --json] [--out FILE] [--device ID] [--category C] [--signal S] [--verdict V] [--limit N] [--db PATH]

cli.dns.reserva_secundario: The resolver you have now stays as the secondary: if Guardiana stops, the machine keeps resolving through it.
cli.dns.solo_guardiana: On this machine Guardiana becomes the only resolver. That is what stops any query slipping past it: systemd-resolved picks among the servers it has, it does not ask them in order, so leaving the old one as a second would mean part of the queries are never seen. The service comes back by itself if it stops, and guardiana dns --restore puts everything back exactly as it was.
cli.verify.dns.guardiana_con_reserva: System DNS: Guardiana (127.0.0.1), with {dns} as the fallback. If Guardiana stops, the machine asks the fallback and those queries are not written down.
cli.verify.dns.por_guardiana: System DNS: Guardiana (127.0.0.1), which forwards to {dns}.
cli.boveda_uso:
Usage:
  guardiana boveda crear [--ruta FOLDER]            creates the vault and shows the 24 words once
  guardiana boveda guardar FILE [--ruta FOLDER]     stores a file, encrypted
  guardiana boveda lista [--ruta FOLDER]            what is inside
  guardiana boveda sacar ID_OR_NAME [--a FILE]      writes a decrypted copy
  guardiana boveda registro [--ruta FOLDER]         every opening, with its chain
  guardiana boveda contrasena [--ruta FOLDER]       changes the password
  guardiana boveda recuperar [--ruta FOLDER]        lost the password: enter with the 24 words and set another
  guardiana boveda trozos [--ruta FOLDER]           splits the 24 words into 5 pieces (3 are enough)
  guardiana boveda juntar                           joins 3 pieces and returns the 24 words
  guardiana boveda capsula DEST_FOLDER              copies the encrypted vault to an external disk, with the reader
  guardiana boveda panel [--ruta FOLDER] [--no-open] opens the vault page in the browser (only on this machine)
Without --ruta, the vault lives in {ruta}.
cli.boveda_clave_distinta: The two passwords do not match. Nothing was changed.
cli.boveda_clave_corta: The password needs at least 10 characters. Nothing was created.
cli.boveda_palabras_titulo: Your 24 recovery words. Shown once only: copy them on paper and keep them away from the computer. Without the password and without these words nobody can open the vault, not even us.
cli.boveda_palabras_confirma: Type «si» once you have them saved
cli.boveda_palabras_pide: Type the 24 words, separated by spaces
cli.boveda_existe_destino: {ruta} already exists; it is not overwritten. Give another destination with --a.
cli.boveda_registro_rota: The log chain breaks at line {n}: someone deleted or changed a line.
cli.boveda_contrasena_cambiada: Password changed. The 24 words stay the same.
cli.boveda_recuperada: Vault opened with the 24 words. Now choose a new password.
cli.boveda_trozos_titulo: Five pieces; any three recover the 24 words. Keep each one in a different place. One piece, or two, reveal nothing.
cli.boveda_juntado: The 24 words, recovered from the pieces:
cli.boveda_capsula: Capsule written at {ruta}: the whole vault, encrypted, with its log.
cli.boveda_capsula_lector: The independent reader goes with it ({lector}): it opens the capsule without GUARDIANA.
cli.boveda_capsula_sin_lector: The independent reader was not found next to the program; the format is published in docs/BOVEDA.md.
cli.boveda_err_clave: Wrong password or words. It is written in the vault's log.
cli.boveda_err_alterado: This object is altered or truncated ({que}); it is not decrypted halfway.

panel.pie: Guardiana runs entirely on this machine. There is no account, no server of ours, and it sends nothing you do not trigger yourself.
panel.sin_sesion_texto: Open the panel from the Guardiana launcher (or from the guardiana observe window), which includes the session key. The key lives only in memory and is not stored as a cookie.
panel.radiografia_lead: Which services this machine is trying to talk to right now, with their category and one sentence per signal. Real figures from the ledger, no rounding.
panel.radiografia_limite: Guardiana sees service names, not which program asked for them nor what content was sent. It never says "malicious": it says what it observed.
panel.sin_consultas_aun: No queries yet. Browse a little and they will show up here.
panel.extracto_lead: Every query on record, with who decided what. Filter, export and verify the chain.
panel.cadena_lead: Every entry carries the fingerprint of the previous one. If someone deleted or changed a line, it shows here.
panel.cadena_ok_recortada: Chain verified: {n} events correct; {p} earlier ones already summarised by retention.
panel.cadena_rota: The chain is broken at event {id}: {motivo}.
panel.dispositivos_lead: Totals per device. A device's detail is visible only from that device, unless its owner shares it.
panel.dispositivos_limite: Until Home Mode is on, only this PC appears here. In Home Mode, Guardiana sees service names, not which app asked for them.
panel.sabe_lead: Everything this program stores, where it stores it, and everything it has sent out of this machine.
panel.s_no_respuestas: Only queries are recorded: name, type, device, time, category and verdict. Never the answers, never the content.
panel.retencion_gratis: detail 24 hours, daily totals 7 days (free plan)
panel.outbound_lead: Every connection the program made by itself: activating the licence, the subscription check once per period, checking the version or updating lists. With whom, when and how many bytes.
panel.outbound_vacio: Guardiana has sent nothing out of this machine.
panel.borrar_lead: Deletes the ledger, the devices, the rules and this record. It cannot be undone.
panel.borrar_confirmar: This deletes everything and cannot be undone. Type DELETE to confirm:
panel.clave_dev: development key, not the release key
panel.estado_limite: Changing the system DNS and the service that starts by itself are for Windows and Linux. On macOS Guardiana only watches.
panel.hogar_lead: Turns this PC into the DNS guardian of the home Wi‑Fi: phones, TV and everything that uses the Wi‑Fi, without installing anything on them.
panel.hogar_estado_on: Home Mode on since {fecha}. Guardiana listens on the IP {ip} of your local network.
panel.hogar_estado_off: Home Mode off. Guardiana listens only on this PC; no port open towards the network.
panel.hogar_que_pasa: When turned on, Guardiana opens ports only on your local network, never towards the internet: the DNS (53), this panel (7443) and the checker page (80). It is recorded in the ledger. Turning it off closes them. The change takes under a minute; if the Wi‑Fi connects later or changes address, Guardiana notices by itself.
panel.hogar_ip_dinamica: Notice: the IP {ip} of this PC is assigned by the router and may change. If it changes, the phones would lose their DNS. Reserve this IP for this PC in the router ("DHCP reservation", usually under Local network › DHCP) or set a fixed IP.
panel.hogar_ip_fija: The IP {ip} of this PC looks fixed. Good.
panel.hogar_ip_desconocida: Could not tell whether the IP {ip} is fixed or assigned by the router. If it changes, the phones would lose their DNS: better reserve it in the router.
panel.hogar_qr_lead: Scan this code with the phone: it opens the step-by-step guide in this panel and a checker.
panel.hogar_url: Or type in the phone's browser:
panel.hogar_router_texto: In the router, under the DHCP settings, set the IP {ip} as the DNS server. Every device on the Wi‑Fi is covered without touching them. If the provider's router does not allow it, use the per-phone guide.
panel.hogar_iphone_pasos: Settings › Wi‑Fi › tap the (i) of your network › Configure DNS › Manual › Add Server › type {ip} › Save. Remove the other servers from the list.
panel.hogar_android_pasos: Settings › Wi‑Fi › long-press your network › Modify › Advanced options › IP settings: Static › DNS 1: {ip}. Many Android phones also require a fixed IP for the phone: pick a free one on your network (for example the one it already has) and leave the rest as it is.
panel.hogar_comprobar_texto: On the phone, open http://comprobar.guardiana.hogar . If the page "This device already goes through Guardiana" loads, it is done. Only Guardiana resolves that name.
panel.hogar_prueba: Home Mode is free and has no trial and no limit. What matters is that this PC stays on.
panel.hogar_limite: Only on the home Wi‑Fi. On mobile data or away from home, the phone does not go through Guardiana. Guardiana sees service names, not which app asked for them. Coverage away from home: coming later. If this PC shuts down or sleeps, phones pointing only at it are left without DNS until it comes back.
panel.hogar_no_admin: Opening the ports and the firewall rule requires running Guardiana as administrator.
panel.hogar_firewall_manual: On this system the firewall rule is added by hand: allow inbound 53/udp, 53/tcp and 7443/tcp only from the local network (ufw: sudo ufw allow from 192.168.0.0/16 to any port 53; firewalld: add dns and port 7443/tcp to the home zone).
panel.hogar_sin_lan: Cannot find a local network address. Connect this PC to the Wi‑Fi or the router and try again.
panel.mi_lead: What Guardiana has recorded about this device, identified by its address on the Wi‑Fi.
panel.mi_consentimiento: This network uses Guardiana. This is what is recorded about this device: service names, time, category. No apps, no content.
panel.mi_compartir: Share my detail with the home panel
panel.mi_compartir_texto: Off: the home panel only sees totals for this device. On: the detail too.
panel.mi_pasa: This device already goes through Guardiana.
panel.mi_no_pasa: This device has not sent any query to Guardiana yet. Follow the guide on the Home Mode page.
panel.mi_no_lan: This page is for the devices on the Wi‑Fi. From this PC, use Snapshot.
panel.comprobador_titulo: This device already goes through Guardiana
panel.comprobador_texto: You got here because the name comprobar.guardiana.hogar was resolved by Guardiana. This device's queries are now recorded on the home Wi‑Fi.
panel.informe_lead: The last seven days, per device, with real figures from the ledger. Nothing leaves home unless you share it.
panel.informe_whatsapp_lead: Your WhatsApp opens with the text already written. Guardiana sends nothing: you send it, if you want.
panel.informe_texto: This week, at home: {dispositivos} devices, {consultas} queries, {rastreadores} trackers detected, {publicidad} advertising, {cortados} cut. Recorded by Guardiana, at home, without sending anything to anyone.
panel.informe_sin_datos: There is not a week of data yet. The report fills itself in.
panel.informe_limite: Counts queries by service name, not traffic or content. "Tracker" and "advertising" come from open lists; "expected" means updates, time, messaging and video calls. No figure is rounded.
panel.compartir_lead: A card with the totals right now, with no service names. It is made in your browser; nothing is sent.
panel.compartir_texto: 60-second snapshot with Guardiana: {servicios} services, {rastreadores} trackers, {nuevos} new destinations, {esperados} expected, {cortados} cut. All recorded at home, without sending anything to anyone.
panel.tarjeta_pie: Guardiana · recorded at home, without sending anything to anyone
panel.reglas_titulo: Rules: what is cut and what is allowed
panel.reglas_lead: No rule exists unless you create it. Every cut records who decided it and when. Undoing never deletes: it records that it was undone.
panel.reglas_inviolables: Never cut, not even with a rule per category: system updates, time, resolvers, recognised messaging and video calls. A device with fewer than 24 hours observed receives no cut.
panel.reglas_nueva_lead: Cut or allow an exact name, a family of names (the domain and everything under it) or a whole category, for one device or for the whole home.
panel.reglas_ninguna: There are no rules. Guardiana only watches.
panel.regla_esperado_prohibido: That cannot be cut by category: it is system updates, time, resolvers, messaging and video calls. If you really want to cut one of those names, create a rule with that exact name.
panel.regla_esperado_confirmar: This may leave this device without updates / without messages. Cut anyway?
panel.regla_patron_invalido: Check the name or the category: it is not valid.
panel.regla_casa_solo_panel: Rules for the whole home are created only from the PC's panel.
panel.regla_creada: Rule created. Every query cut will be recorded with this rule.
panel.cortar_confirmar_dispositivo: Cut {nombre} for this device: from now on Guardiana will answer that it does not exist. It can be undone in Rules.
panel.modo_bloqueo_titulo: How what is cut gets answered
panel.modo_bloqueo_lead: By default, "that name does not exist" (NXDOMAIN). The alternative answers the address 0.0.0.0. Applied when Guardiana restarts.
panel.mi_reglas_lead: Only you, from this device, can create and undo them.
panel.verify_lead: The same thing guardiana verify prints: facts, not promises. If something does not add up, it shows here.
panel.verify_limite: The signature and the public record only make sense for released versions. How to check by hand, without trusting the program: docs/VERIFY.md in the repository.
panel.licencia_lead: The complete guardian is free and never expires: this PC and Home Mode. Plus adds the weekly report, the ledger with no day limit and, with every version, the up-to-date lists explained. 7-day free trial; then monthly or yearly, cancel whenever you want.
panel.licencia_gratis: Free plan, no Plus. Guardiana has been watching for {h} hours; the Plus trial can start after 24.
panel.licencia_prueba: Plus trial: {d} days left (ends on {fecha}). When it ends the free plan returns; nothing is charged.
panel.licencia_prueba_texto: This counter lives on your machine. Reinstalling resets it. We trust you.
panel.licencia_prueba_agotada: The Plus trial ended on {fecha}. You stay on the free plan: everything works the same, except the weekly report and the unlimited ledger. To continue with Plus, activate a key or a file.
panel.licencia_clave_lead: The key arrives by email when you pay. One connection to {host}, started by you, to activate it; then one check per billing period (monthly or yearly), recorded in "What Guardiana knows about you". Nothing else leaves your machine.
panel.licencia_archivo_lead: For those who do not want even that connection: ask us for the signed licence file of the period and paste its contents here. Nothing leaves your machine.
panel.licencia_dev: This program carries the development key: licence files cannot be checked until the released version.
panel.licencia_limite: Without Plus, everything else keeps working; this PC's DNS never breaks. Cancelling the subscription deletes nothing.
panel.licencia_err_formato: The licence file does not have the expected format.
panel.licencia_err_firma: The signature of the licence file is not Guardiana's. Nothing was activated.
panel.licencia_err_clave: The payment provider did not accept the key: {motivo}.
panel.licencia_err_red: Could not connect to the payment provider: {motivo}. The key was not activated; the attempted connection is on record.
panel.hogar_suspension: Notice: this PC goes to sleep by itself (plugged in: {ac}; on battery: {dc}). While it sleeps, phones pointing only at it are left without DNS. Set it to "Never" in Settings › System › Power & battery › Screen and sleep, or add the router as secondary DNS on the phones.
panel.hogar_suspension_nunca: This PC does not go to sleep by itself. Good: the phones will not lose their DNS because of that.
panel.hueco: Guardiana was not watching between {desde} and {hasta}. It is on record.
panel.licencia_gratis_puede_probar: Free plan, no Plus. You can now try Plus for 7 days, no card and no account.
panel.licencia_prueba_pronto: The Plus trial starts once Guardiana has been watching for 24 hours; it has been {h}. That way you do not spend a trial day waiting for activity to show up.
panel.licencia_prueba_usada: The 7-day trial has already been used on this machine.
panel.licencia_probar_lead: No card, no account, no connection: the counter lives on your machine. On the seventh day the free plan returns and nothing is charged.
panel.licencia_invitacion: The complete guardian is already yours. Plus adds the weekly report of the home and the ledger with no day limit. You can try it for 7 days, no card.
panel.licencia_comprobacion_al_dia: {periodo} subscription. Guardiana checks the key once per period: the next time on {fecha}; it is recorded below.
panel.licencia_comprobacion_pendiente: {periodo} subscription. The key is due for a check; Guardiana will do it on its next pass. If it cannot before {limite}, Plus switches off and the free plan continues.
panel.licencia_comprobacion_fallida: {periodo} subscription. The key could not be checked (no connection to the payment provider). Guardiana retries every hour; if it cannot before {limite}, Plus switches off and the free plan continues.
panel.licencia_comprobacion_no_toca: The subscription is not due for a check yet.
panel.licencia_plus_cancelada: The payment provider says the subscription ended on {fecha}. You stay on the free plan; everything works the same, except the weekly report and the unlimited ledger.
panel.licencia_plus_caducada: The licence file expired on {fecha}. You stay on the free plan. To continue with Plus, paste the file of the new period.
panel.licencia_plus_sin_comprobar: Guardiana could not check the subscription during {fecha} and Plus switched off. The free plan continues. When the connection is back, activate the key again.
panel.informe_ejemplo_aviso: EXAMPLE · These are not readings from your home: it is a sample of how the weekly report looks with Plus.
panel.informe_plus_invitacion: Plus gathers the observed activity of your home into a weekly report. Each phone's detail stays visible only from that phone. You can try it for 7 days, no card.
panel.informe_lead_ejemplo: This is how the weekly report looks with Plus: the last seven days, per device. With Plus the figures are the real ones from the ledger; nothing leaves home unless you share it.
panel.dns_card_titulo: This PC does not go through Guardiana yet
panel.dns_card_texto: Guardiana is installed, but this PC's DNS still points at the router, so its queries do not show here. When you press the button, Guardiana becomes this PC's DNS. An exact copy of the setting is saved and it can be undone in "Status".
panel.dns_card_boton: Point this PC's DNS at Guardiana
panel.e_dns_restaurar: Undo: restore the DNS as it was
panel.pdf_pie: guardianagroup.com · generated by GUARDIANA on the PC of this home, without going through any server
panel.pdf_generado: Generated on {fecha} from the local panel
panel.pdf_descargado: The browser downloaded it as {nombre} (in its downloads folder; Chrome and Edge on a PC ask where to save it).
panel.cambios_lead: What Guardiana changed on this PC because someone asked, and who asked. Turning Home Mode on or off, pointing or restoring the DNS. None of this happens on its own.
panel.lectura_empresas: Who it talked to in the last 24 hours
panel.lectura_empresas_lead: Who is behind each name, according to our list of companies. It is a label, not a verdict: it says who owns the name, not what it does.
panel.lectura_empresas_ninguna: No name from the companies list yet.
panel.lectura_callado: Not going through Guardiana for {min} minutes while the rest of the home keeps going: it may have turned on a VPN, changed its DNS or left home.
panel.lectura_relay: This device checks iCloud Private Relay. If it is on, whatever Safari does leaves outside Guardiana.
panel.lectura_evasiones: Tried to use a foreign encrypted DNS {n} times in 24 hours; those queries do not go through Guardiana.
panel.lectura_evasion_una: Tried to use a foreign encrypted DNS once in 24 hours; that query does not go through Guardiana.
panel.ia_lead: An artificial-intelligence agent on your machine works with your keys: your folders, your accounts, your network. Here you see which services it talks to, from which device and when.
panel.ia_limite: Guardiana checks where it talks, not what it reads. It sees service names; it does not see the files a program opens nor what travels inside each connection. What leaves through an app’s own encrypted DNS or a VPN does not pass through here either, and is recorded when detected.
panel.ia_servicios_titulo: AI services seen in the last 7 days
panel.ia_servicios_lead: From our open list of artificial-intelligence services. One showing up does not mean it is doing anything wrong: it means that device talked to it.
panel.ia_sin_servicios: No AI service seen on this machine yet.
panel.alcance_lead: You gave an agent permission for a task. Write here which services it needs for that, and Guardiana tells you everything that went beyond. It cuts nothing: it only shows you, and cutting stays your decision in Rules.
panel.alcance_nuevo_lead: One service per line. The domain and everything under it counts: writing github.com includes api.github.com.
panel.alcance_borrado: Scope removed: this device has nothing declared again.
panel.alcance_fuera: {n} names beyond what was declared in 24 hours
panel.alcance_fuera_ninguno: Nothing beyond what was declared in the last 24 hours.
panel.alcance_esperado_nota: System updates, time, resolvers and recognised messaging never count as "beyond": they are the machine keeping itself alive, not the agent.
panel.alcance_limite: This checks destinations, not intentions: it says which services a device talked to, not what it did with them nor which files it opened. An agent working only with files on your disk does not show up here, because it asks for no name.
panel.bov_lead: Your documents, encrypted on this machine with your master password. Nothing leaves here: not to us, not to anyone.
panel.bov_crear_lead: Choose a master password of at least 10 characters. Without it and without the 24 words you will see next, nobody can open the vault, not even us.
panel.bov_palabras_texto: Shown once only. Copy them on paper and keep them away from the computer: they open the vault if you lose the password.
panel.bov_recuperar_lead: Type the 24 words and choose a new password. The words keep working afterwards.
panel.bov_bloqueo: It locks itself after 10 idle minutes.
panel.bov_guardar_lead: It is encrypted here, on this machine, with its own key. The original is not touched.
panel.bov_registro_ok: The log chain is intact: {n} lines.
panel.bov_registro_rota: The chain breaks at line {n}: someone deleted or changed a line.
panel.bov_clave_corta: The password needs at least 10 characters.
panel.bov_clave_distinta: The two passwords do not match.
panel.bov_cerrada: The vault is locked. Open it with the password.
panel.bov_salido: The vault is locked and this page no longer answers. You can close the tab or go back to the panel.
panel.bov_limite: Limits, said here: the password travels from this page to the program inside your machine (127.0.0.1), never outside. Keys are wiped from memory when the vault is locked. There is no back door: lose the password and the 24 words and the content is lost. The format is public and a separate reader opens the vault without GUARDIANA.
panel.bov_espera: One moment: the password is turned into a key slowly, on purpose.
